title: Getting Started With Org Mode
summary: Harry Schwartz gives a roughly hour-long tour of Emacs Org mode as an outliner, task manager, markup language and agenda tool. He demonstrates how he uses it for documents, presentations and todo lists.
why: Recommended as a thorough introduction showing what Org mode can do for personal organization.

quote.text: which is a great demonstration on Emacs and Org Mode's potential as an organizational tool.
